title: The motel application, iii
logline: Wednesday. The interview at the desk. The manager asks if he can stay awake. The ice machine hums. The strip draws the hum as a line under the last panel — the first time.

panels.composition: The Driftwood Motel's lobby, day. A MANAGER behind the desk (the strip draws him as a polo shirt with a name tag; the tag blank). WOOD across it in the nine-dollar suit.

characters.pose: the manager: a polo and a blank tag

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a motel lobby by day with a manager in a polo shirt with a blank name tag behind the desk and a thin man in a slightly short dark suit across from him
image.notes: Cast note: motel_guest slot used for the manager; he is a polo and a blank tag.

panels.composition: The suit's short sleeve on the counter. The manager's eyes on it. Then not.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a suit sleeve an inch too short resting on a motel counter

panels.composition: The manager sliding the application back. A start date written on it.
props: the form, a date on it

balloons.text: You're awake at night anyway. Says so.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a manager sliding a form back across a motel desk with a date written on it

panels.composition: Wood at the glass door, leaving. Down the hall, the ice machine. Under the panel, for the first time: a flat unbroken line.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man in a suit at a motel's glass door with an ice machine visible down a hallway, a flat line running beneath the panel, no words
image.notes: The hum line's first appearance. It runs under motel panels from here to 2020.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: 'You're awake at night anyway. Says so.' The hum line begins.
